title: Listening Drill — Repairing old clocks
description: Interview. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Repairing old clocks
sections.transcript:
HOST: You work on repairing clocks for a museum. What got your team started? People often think projects like yours begin with a large grant.

GUEST: Ours started with a donation. At the time our biggest obstacle was missing diagrams. We had to change the plan before we could make proper progress.

HOST: What surprised you once you started getting results?

GUEST: We discovered hidden marks. It helped us improve date estimates. That wasn't a goal we had written into the original proposal.

HOST: And what happens next?

GUEST: We'll photograph the mechanisms in more detail. Then we'll decide whether to expand.
